items.title: Recall And Debt Build Might Change The Case For Investing In Boston Scientific (BSX)
items.summary: Boston Scientific recently announced a fixed income offering of senior, unsecured, callable fixed rate notes and is also managing a voluntary Class II FDA recall of 134 Nalu Neurostimulation System components initiated in September 2026. The combination of higher leverage from new debt, sizeable capital commitments, and an ongoing neuromodulation recall puts Boston Scientific's cost structure, product reliability, and balance sheet discipline under closer scrutiny.
